roles.text: AI Application Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer

statement.label: In brief
statement.intro: 8 years in software, building web, mobile, and cloud systems for aviation logistics, travel, and SaaS. I write front-end and back-end code, help set technical direction, and lead a team. I like practical problems and systems that just work.

bullets: Built a Progressive Web App with a component-based TypeScript front end, integrated with Node.js / Express back-end services over REST APIs.
Led the UI revamp of a telecom service application, improving usability and operational efficiency.
Acted as technical point of contact and escalation for complex issues, coordinating with project managers in an Agile team.
Diagnosed and resolved network, hardware and operating-system issues remotely and on-site, keeping systems available.

experience.company: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Limited (HACTL)
bullets: Implemented a hybrid-cloud data platform on Microsoft Azure with a data pipeline and Power BI reporting, optimizing operational time by at least 10% and reducing resource loss by at least 5%.
Improved and maintained mission-critical enterprise applications (COSAC-Plus, COSAC-Mobile) through UI revamp projects.
Coordinated cross-functional teams and authored documentation and guidelines for smooth handovers.
Developed and enhanced SAP ERP module programs and provided technical support.
Partnered with business analysts to gather requirements and advise on change impacts and technical limitations.
Using Microsoft Azure platform to build an object classification mobile application with computer vision technology

projects.title: UCruising PWA Application
projects.summary: Designed, built, and shipped UCruising end-to-end as a single-codebase Progressive Web App deployed across iOS, Android, Windows, and WeChat.

projects.title: UCruising - CMS & ERP
projects.summary: Developed a web-based back-office system to manage app content and users, implement core business logic for [bookings / pricing / orders], and handle accounting functions including [invoicing, payment reconciliation, and financial reporting].

projects.title: COSAC-Plus: Air Cargo Management System (HACTL Solutions)
projects.summary: Migrated COSAC-Plus, HACTL's enterprise air cargo management system, from vanilla JavaScript to AngularJS; developed and debugged core functions in Java and SQL on Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure; and provided 24/7 on-call production support.

projects.title: Offisky App
projects.summary: Revamped the UI, built new features, and provided customer support for Offisky, a cloud virtual office SaaS platform delivering hosted PBX, virtual phone, and messaging services to Canadian SMBs.

projects.title: UOB | ART CENTRAL 2022 – The Bloom of Water Lilies - Virtual Panorama Web Application
projects.summary: Built a serverless photo pipeline (Node.js, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3) for a UOB-commissioned interactive art installation at Art Central Hong Kong, stitching multi-camera shots into panoramas for visitors to download.

projects.title: Academic Project - Dog Breed Image Classification: CNN vs. R-CNN Performance Study
projects.summary:
Built and benchmarked CNN and R-CNN models in TensorFlow for dog breed classification, comparing accuracy and inference performance, and deployed the selected model to an Android app.

- a demo video for short description and demo the application in Cantonese

projects.title: Academic Project - Full-Stack Web Application: Multi-Paradigm Development
projects.summary:
Built a PHP RESTful API with parallel Angular and Elm front ends to compare object-oriented and functional approaches on maintainability, type safety, and productivity.

- a demo video for short description and demo the application in English

projects.title: Academic Project - Household Task Management Mobile App
projects.summary:
Developed a household task management mobile app enabling employers to assign tasks to domestic helpers, with completion tracking and automated SMS notifications to reduce errors and missed work.

- a demo video for short description and demo the application in Cantonese

tools.name: BMI Calculator
tools.summary: BMI, or Body Mass Index, is a measure of body fat based on a person's weight and height. It is commonly used to determine if a person is underweight, normal weight, overweight, or obese. BMI can help individuals assess their overall health and potential risks for diseases associated with excess weight
